title: SideStream Hack 2026
place: Carasso Center, Technion. Faculties: Biotech & Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering.
format: Each table file is {columns, rows}. rows are arrays in columns order. JSON null is a database NULL. Numbers are unchanged SQLite values (integral floats are written as integers). Nothing is imputed.

views.title: Capped global
views.description: Routes that have a capped global annual net, highest first.

views.title: Net $/kg
views.description: Routes that have a net value per kg of waste, highest first.

views.title: Israel
views.description: Routes that have a capped Israel annual net, highest first.

views.title: Sponsor × Israel
views.description: Routes with a sponsor link, a sponsor mention, or israel_linked, and a positive net per kg. Sponsor-linked rows come first, then hackathon fit, then capped Israel (or capped global) annual net.

views.title: Hackathon fit
views.description: Positive net per kg, novelty at least 3, and flags do not contain already_done. Ordered by hackathon fit, then capped global net at a 10% market share, then net per kg.

views.title: Sanity-capped
views.description: sanity_pass is 1, a product market figure is present, and capped global annual net is present. Ordered by that capped net.

views.title: Top per stream
views.description: One route per stream: the row with the highest capped global annual net, breaking ties with net per kg.

flags.no_reference: No reference URL or DOI on the route.
flags.price_estimate: The product price is an estimate.
flags.net_nonpositive: Net value per kg is zero or negative.
flags.price_specialty_scale: Price is tagged specialty rather than bulk.
flags.market_size_unknown: No product market size is recorded.
flags.market_share_gt_30pct: Priced global output is more than 30% of the product market (market_share_needed > 0.3).
flags.capped_by_market: Annual value was limited by the product market.
flags.price_harmonised: Ranking price differs from the price as entered.
flags.gas_stream_per_kg_gas: Availability is a gas mass, so per-kg figures are per kg of gas.
flags.partner_mass_in_yield: Yield counts mass from a partner stream.
flags.child_stream: Stream is a child of a parent stream.
flags.value_shared_with_partner: Value is shared with a partner stream.
flags.yield_gt_1: Yield is above 1 kg product per kg waste.
flags.israel_named_row_with_global_tonnage: An Israel-named row is carrying a global tonnage.
flags.price_research_scale: Price is a research or lab-scale price.
flags.heat_stream: Stream is heat rather than a material.

notes: Blank cells are unknown. They were not filled with zero.
gross_usd_per_kg_waste = price_usd_per_kg × yield_kg_per_kg_waste wherever both inputs are present.
net_usd_per_kg_waste = gross_usd_per_kg_waste − process_cost_usd_per_kg_waste wherever both inputs are present.
uncapped_net_usd_per_yr_global = net_usd_per_kg_waste × global_availability_t_per_yr × 1000 wherever both inputs are present.
net_usd_per_yr_israel = net_usd_per_kg_waste × israel_availability_t_per_yr × 1000 when Israel tonnage is present and not zero. When Israel tonnage is blank or zero, this annual column is blank.

market_share_needed = price_usd_per_kg × product_output_t_per_yr × 1000 / product_market_usd_per_yr on the 1037 routes where price, output, and market are present. 1 means priced global output equals the whole product market. market_share_gt_30pct is set exactly when the ratio is above 0.3.

Where price, output, and market are present, capped_net_usd_per_yr_global = uncapped_net × min(1, market / revenue), and capped_net_usd_per_yr_global_10pct_share uses 10% of the market in that same cap. revenue = price × product tonnes × 1000.
hackathon_fit_score = novelty_1to5 + demo_feasibility_1to5 + israel_fit_1to5 + trl_fit_1to5 on every route.
route_matrix.price_usd_per_kg is the ranking price. route_value and the products table keep the catalogue price. They differ where the price_harmonised flag is set.
Ranked views are the database view order, exported as route id lists. Filtering in the site keeps that order until you sort a column.
